minimal_operator_actions: Confirm camera seat and clamped base are rigid and unchanged since the supplied photos; report last remount if known, or explicitly unknown. Do not loosen/reseat to find it.

Add two close-ups from front and side with a ruler/tape adjacent to the camera/bracket in the measured plane, showing the visible flange-to-gripper mounting seam and screw positions. Include a readable scale and note ruler resolution; report inaccessible landmarks instead of moving the arm.

Add one scaled overhead view tying the base mounting plate, front/rear/side table edges, cable hatch rectangle and camera pole foot to the same visible references. Include tabletop-to-base mounting-plane height if not flush. Measurements or CAD may replace ruler photos; unscaled photos remain topology evidence only.

Place and secure matte high-contrast printed/textured paper on the table in the wrist camera's central view, away from jaws. The small glossy gum box alone is not an adequate scene. Do not move/enable the arm to aim it; automation rechecks view and depth before choosing ROI.

Before any separately approved motion, keep jaws empty, clear loose items/chair from the swept region, and manage cable loops without disconnecting peripherals or disturbing mounts. Stop if routing requires moving the arm. Confirm accessible emergency stop and onsite supervision.
